Appendix (Rules for the Implementation of the Personnel Regulations of the Ministry of National Defense and its Affiliated Institutions) <No. 793, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This regulation shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 Omitted

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Regulations) Omitted

⑨ The following amendments are made to part of the "Rules for the Implementation of the Order for the Implementation of Student Military Training":

Paragraph 1 of Article 9 and Paragraph 2 of Articles 10 and 11 are amended to read "Minister of Education."

⑩ Omitted
